summary: @ornikar/eslint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unpacks it, marks it executable, and uses it to run a 727KB obfuscated sibling script `math_init.js` during `npm install`. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming, rotating string-array decoder). An ESLint configuration package has no legitimate reason to fetch a second language runtime or execute an obfuscated payload at install time; this matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to evade Node-based scanning and results in arbitrary code execution on any machine installing the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
